claims.evidence: 54 RAW files in the PRIDE list, each claimed once; MQ_txtfolder.zip and mqpar.xml are not raw data.

claims.location: source name / characteristics[cell line] / characteristics[biological replicate] / comment[technical replicate]
claims.value: 9 B-LCLs x 2 experiments x 3 technical runs
claims.evidence: mqpar.xml <filePaths> and <experiments> are parallel lists of 54 entries (e.g. 1001.raw = S9037_1). Experiment suffix 1-3 = biological replicate 1, 4-6 = replicate 2 (paper: two experiments per cell line, three technical replicates each). Prefix codes map to IHW cell lines 9037 SWEIG, 9047 PLH, 9050 MOU, 9051 PITOUT, 9064 AMALA, 9087 STEINLIN, 9088 PF04015, 9089 BOB (paper Table 1). Prefix RN is not defined anywhere: assigned to CD114, the only remaining of the nine cell lines (inference).
Paper Table 1 DNA typing profile (DQA1*, DQB1*). AMALA DQA1 given as 05:01/05:03 and written as both alleles.
HLA-DQ molecules purified with anti-DQ antibody SPV-L3.
Lysis buffer contained 25 mM iodoacetamide; peptides acid eluted.

claims.evidence: Cellosaurus queries; IHW workshop IDs matched (IHW09037 etc.). Sex from Cellosaurus, not the deposit.

claims.value: celiac disease for CD114 rows; not available otherwise
claims.evidence: Paper: CD114 derived from a celiac disease patient (Cellosaurus DI NCIt C26714). IHW lines' donor health status is not stated in the deposit.
Protocol: normalized collision energy 25%; HCD is assumed for the Q Exactive (not stated explicitly).
dataProcessingProtocol: unspecific enzyme option selected, no miscleavages; mqpar enzymeMode 4 with empty enzymes. Natural HLA ligands, no digestion.
Protocol: main search 6 ppm, fragment 20 ppm; mqpar FTMS tolerance 20 ppm, firstSearchTol 20.

claims.value: Oxidation (M), Deamidated (N,Q), Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, all variable; no fixed
claims.evidence: Protocol and mqpar variableModifications; fixedModifications empty.

limitations: RN experiment prefix is undefined in mqpar and paper; mapping to CD114 is inferred by elimination, so disease celiac disease and CD114 identity on those 6 rows are inferred.
Paper notes some experiments gave very low ion volumes and were excluded from analysis; all 54 raw files are still annotated since they are deposited.
Sex comes from Cellosaurus; age, ancestry, individual, passage, culture medium (RPMI + 10% FCS in paper, not entered) not entered as per-sample facts.
HCD dissociation assumed; raw headers not inspected.
mhc typing lists only DQA1/DQB1 (the targeted molecule); AMALA DQA1 listed as both 05:01 and 05:03 from an ambiguous 05:01/05:03 call. mhc typing method left out (not stated).
Cell line names validate with OLS warnings only (CLO/BTO/EFO lack these Cellosaurus-only IHW lines).
tools reconcile flags cleavage_agent_unsupported; this is a false positive because the protocol states the unspecific enzyme option explicitly.
Factor value[mhc typing] chosen to express the compared DQ variant (DQ2.5/DQ2.2/DQ7.5); alternative would be none.
